Notes: Unicorn Field Engineer in Sector 35. Dialog captured 2026-11-10 14:54:49-14:55:02 ET. 'We're ready, Sir.' runs {spawngroup S35E}: towers and the Energy Accumulator spawn at once, then the scraped defense waves, then Field Marshal Cha'Khaz at +10:13 and Field Support Cha'Khaz at +11:33. The encounter despawns and can be started again if the accumulator (or all three towers) die, or after a 60-minute timeout, or 3 minutes after both bosses are dead. Standing at zone-in are only the Engineer, the Zone Exit, and normal canyon trash.

assist.Text: We were told to assist you, Sir.

what.Text: Ok, what should we do to help out then?

assist.Text: Wonderful!  You see, our ship was never meant for close combat.  I think we were shot down by aliens, and they keep attacking us, making it impossible for me to start the repair process.

Text: I will deploy my last set of service towers.  Your job will be to protect them from the aliens.  I'll be inside the ship monitoring the repair process making sure it goes well.  Once the ship is repaired I'll take us all out of here!
Now, are you ready for this task, or will I have to explain it again?

ready.Text: Good.  Now keep those aliens at bay!{spawngroup S35E}
